svg.aria-label: Scatter plot: trains that were delayed in September were also delayed in October.
svg.text: Each dot is one train. Further right: the more delay it had in September.
Further up: the more delay the same train had in October.
Each dot = one train (random sample of 1,600 out of 42,003) · Data: Deutsche Bahn timetable data (IRIS) · September–October 2026
